jobs.title: General Warehouse Associate
jobs.description:
Wise Staffing Group is NOW HIRING multiple Warehouse Associates in the West Chicago, IL area! Multiple shifts available!


Job Summary:

We are seeking a Warehouse Associate to join a fast-paced warehouse and distribution operation. This position supports inventory management, shipping, receiving, and order fulfillment. This role is responsible for performing hands-on warehouse duties, including picking, packing, sorting, material handling, and inventory activities.


Responsibilities:

  • Receive, inspect, store, pick, and pack products to support daily shipping and fulfillment operations.
  • Safely operate warehouse equipment to move materials throughout the facility.
  • Perform inventory counts and maintain accurate inventory records.
  • Pick and pack orders accurately and efficiently.
  • Assist with shipping and receiving activities as needed.
  • Load, unload, move, and organize materials throughout the warehouse.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Follow all company safety procedures and warehouse operating guidelines.
  • Perform a combination of equipment operation and manual warehouse tasks throughout the shift.


Qualifications:

  • Previous warehouse experience required.
  • Cherry picker experience preferred.
  • Ability to lift, carry, move, and handle materials throughout the shift.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Ability to perform repetitive physical tasks while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow instructions.
  • Reliable attendance and dependable work ethic.


Why Wise Staffing Group:

  • Weekly pay
  • Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance
  • Temp-to-hire opportunity


Benefits:

  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Vision insurance


Work Location: In person

Company Description

Headquartered in Tupelo, MS, Wise Staffing Group is a full-service human resources company specializing in temporary and career staffing with an emphasis on providing excellent customer service. Wise Staffing Group become one of the largest staffing services in the Southeast United States. Since 1987, we have proven to be one of the most respected providers of innovative staffing solutions. We have developed and offer industry leading services that provide dependable, qualified workers. Each office sets and maintains the same high standards of operation and ongoing commitment to quality services. We consistently work toward superior performance in fulfilling client needs.

jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist
jobs.via: via Frito Lay Jobs - Search Hires Today
jobs.description:
Job Description

Warehouse Specialist help drive the success of Frito-Lay's warehouse and distribution operations by ensuring products are accurately received, stored, and prepared for delivery. This role supports inventory flow, order fulfillment, and warehouse organization while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational efficiency. If you enjoy physical work, value accuracy, and thrive in a fast-paced team environment, you'll find rewarding opportunities to contribute to our supply chain every day.

What You'll Do

  • Accept inbound deliveries by unloading trailers and inspecting products for accuracy and condition.

  • Pick, sort, and stage merchandise for outbound shipments in accordance with warehouse processes and customer requirements.

  • Operate forklifts, electric pallet jacks, and other material-handling equipment after successfully completing required training.

  • Move inventory throughout the warehouse and store products in designated locations using established handling procedures.

  • Check product quantities, labels, and shipping documents to help maintain accurate inventory records.

  • Assist with cycle counts, inventory replenishment, stock rotation, and warehouse organization efforts.

  • Build, wrap, and stabilize pallets to ensure products are protected during storage and transportation.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area by completing housekeeping tasks and identifying potential hazards.

  • Follow company policies, food safety guidelines, and warehouse operating procedures to support a safe workplace.

  • Coordinate with warehouse teammates, supervisors, and transportation personnel to meet daily shipping, receiving, and service objectives.

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years old.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, holidays, and overtime based on operational requirements.

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, push, pull, and relocate products throughout the work shift.

  • Ability to remain on your feet for extended periods while walking, bending, reaching, climbing, kneeling, and performing repetitive physical movements.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow written and verbal instructions accurately.

  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team-oriented warehouse environment.

  • Previous experience in warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, distribution, or material handling is helpful but not required.

Physical Requirements

  • Perform physically demanding warehouse duties throughout scheduled shifts.

  • Work in an environment that may include varying temperatures, moving equipment, and moderate to high noise levels.

  • Safely operate powered industrial vehicles and warehouse equipment while following established safety practices.

Skills & Competencies

  • Dedication to workplace safety

  • Effective teamwork and communication

  • Dependability and accountability

  • Accuracy in inventory and order handling

  • Planning, organization, and time management

  • Critical thinking and sound decision-making

  • Ability to perform efficiently in a fast-paced warehouse setting

About Frito-Lay

Frito-Lay, a division of PepsiCo, relies on dedicated warehouse professionals to help move products efficiently throughout its distribution network. As a Warehouse Specialist, you'll play an important role in receiving, storing, and shipping products while supporting safe warehouse operations, maintaining inventory accuracy, and delivering the dependable service our customers expect.

Q: How physically demanding are Frito-Lay production jobs?

A: Production and warehouse positions can be physically demanding and may involve prolonged standing, repetitive movements, lifting, bending, and working extended shifts. Employees are also expected to follow strict workplace safety procedures.

Q:How many hours is part-time at Frito-Lay?
A: Part-time roles generally run under 30 hours/week, though hours can start low and Frito-Lay is often quick to offer more hours to reliable workers.

Q:Does Frito-Lay pay overtime?
A: Yes — 71% of surveyed employees said they receive overtime pay for their role at Frito-Lay. Some part-time reviewers note overtime access can be limited.

Q:How often do Frito-Lay employees get paid?
A: Most reviews indicate Frito-Lay pays weekly.

jobs.description:
Chicago Role Highlights

At a Glance

  • New Opening: Part-Time Warehouse With Benefits — Part-time Hours Full-time Benefits
  • Location: Chicago, IL
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in customer service.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

Rewards

  • Earnings: $21-$23/Hour (approx. $23.1k/Year)
  • Benefits: Flexible scheduling available.
  • Earn extra cash with a stable local employer.

Day-to-Day

  • Apply your your professional skills skills in a flexible Chicago environment.

About UPS & Our Culture

It sounds too good to be true — part-time hours with full-time quality benefits. But at UPS, it has been the reality for decades, and it is one of the primary reasons our part-time workforce has some of the highest retention rates in the logistics industry. Our Part-Time Warehouse positions with benefits are the rare exception in the American labor market — roles where Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision coverage, pension contributions, and paid personal time are available to associates working as few as 17.5 hours per week. When you search for warehouse jobs with benefits near me, nothing else on the market delivers what UPS does at the part-time level.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I took this job because my family needed health insurance and I could not afford individual coverage. UPS's Teamsters medical plan costs me a fraction of what individual insurance costs, covers my entire family, and is genuinely better coverage than what my spouse gets at their full-time job. I work 20 hours a week, I am home by 9:30 AM every morning, and my family's healthcare is completely handled. For anyone searching for warehouse jobs with benefits at part-time hours, UPS is completely in its own league." - Current Part-Time Associate with Benefits, Nashville, TN.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Warehouse Associate with Benefits, you work a structured 3.5 to 5 hour sort shift inside our package center, performing the core loading, sorting, and unloading functions that keep the UPS delivery network running — and accessing a benefits package that most part-time employers do not even attempt to offer.

  • Core Sort Functions: Execute UPS's standard sort operation tasks — unloading trailers, sorting packages on conveyor systems, and loading delivery vehicles in sequence order — building skill and speed across all three functions over time on a consistent part-time schedule.
  • Benefits Enrollment Navigation: Work with UPS's onboarding team to enroll in Teamsters union medical, dental, and vision benefits, understand your pension accrual schedule, and register for the UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance program within your first weeks on the job.
  • Consistent Schedule Reliability: Maintain consistent attendance across your assigned part-time shift window — the foundation on which your Teamsters union seniority, annual wage progression, and long-term benefits eligibility are all built.

Benefits & Perks

This UPS part-time position includes the full Teamsters union benefits package — medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and eligible dependents, a defined-benefit pension plan, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance covering up to $25,000 in education costs. Weekly paychecks and contractual annual wage progression raises complete a benefits offering that no comparable part-time warehouse job with benefits in this market can match.

Come Join Us!

From apartments in New York to hospitals and stadiums in Dallas, libraries at prestigious universities to creating modern retail experiences, our teams contribute architectural glass and building products to projects that shape the way people live, work, heal, learn, and play. At OBE, the work of our employees truly matters. With over 6,500 employees, we operate more than 80 manufacturing and distribution facilities in five countries. You can see some of our favorite projects here.

Start your journey with OBE and help us build the future.

What You'll Get To Do

The Warehouse Staff is responsible for picking and checking products in the warehouse to fill customer orders.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Physically pulls and packs orders to quality standards
  • Verifies accuracy against all orders
  • Marks boxes/pallets for route and stop designation
  • Reboxing of product
  • Wraps pallets by hand to insure stability
  • Restocks and puts product away carefully and safely
  • Responsible for the cleanliness of all work areas
  • Communicates stock needs and discrepancies to appropriate personnel
  • Communicates challenges inhibiting accurate and timely order pulling process
  • Responsible for participating in yearly inventory as required
  • Ability to listen effectively and follow instructions
  • Regular and predictable attendance, safely perform tasks and adherence to all safety policies and procedures are essential functions of the job.

What OBE Offers You

OBE Privacy Policy

OBE will not discharge or discriminate against employees or applicants for discussing, disclosing, or inquiring about their own or others' pay.

jobs.description:
Position in Chicago, IL

Snapshot

  • Flexible contract/gig opportunity in Chicago.
  • Worksite: Chicago, IL
  • Benefits: A competitive compensation package is offered.
  • Flexible Role in Chicago: Part-time Morning Warehouse — Done By 9AM
  • This role centers on your professional skills within the Package Logistics space in Chicago.
  • Compensation: $17-$20/Hour (approx. $22.9k/Year)
  • Company: UPS
  • This Chicago-based role is an excellent opportunity for professionals skilled in relevant skills.
  • Our UPS team in Chicago, IL is growing.
  • Benefit from working in Chicago, a key hub for the Package Logistics industry.

About UPS & Our Culture

Four to five hours. That is all UPS asks of its morning preload associates — and in return, you receive Teamsters union wages, full medical benefits, a pension contribution, and a completely free day starting before 9:30 AM. Our Part-Time Morning Warehouse position is the best-kept secret in the local job market for parents who need school-drop-off mornings free, freelancers who want their afternoons uninterrupted, and anyone who simply values owning their day. When you search for morning warehouse jobs near me that pay well and end early, UPS preload is the answer that consistently surprises people who find it.

What Our Team Says (Employee Reviews)

"I drop my kids off at school at 7:45 AM and I am already done with my UPS shift. I work 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM, and the entire rest of my day belongs to me. The union wage plus the morning shift differential adds up to a paycheck that covers my car payment and insurance with money left over. I have recommended this to every parent I know who is looking for morning warehouse jobs near me — nothing else in this market ends this early and pays this well." - Current Morning Preload Associate, San Antonio, TX.

Role Overview & Responsibilities

As a UPS Part-Time Morning Warehouse Associate, you work the preload sort shift — typically 4:00 AM to 8:30 AM — inside our package center, sorting inbound overnight freight and building outbound package car loads that every UPS driver depends on to run a clean, efficient delivery route throughout the day.

  • Early Morning Inbound Sort: Process inbound overnight package volume from the network's linehaul trailers, sorting every parcel to the correct outbound car or lane using barcode scanning and load chart reference during the critical pre-departure window.
  • Package Car Load Building: Build delivery vehicle loads in precise stop-sequence order, ensuring every driver can pull their route efficiently from the first stop to the last without searching for misplaced freight inside the vehicle.
  • Shift Completion by 9 AM: Consistently finish your sort assignment and vehicle inspection before the morning departure window, freeing your entire day for family, school, freelance work, or a second career without any schedule conflict whatsoever.

Benefits & Perks

UPS Part-Time Morning Associates earn a meaningful early-morning shift differential on top of Teamsters union base wages, with full medical, dental, and vision benefits, pension accrual, paid personal days, and UPS Earn & Learn tuition assistance — all on a schedule that ends before most people finish their morning coffee. Weekly direct-deposit paychecks make this one of the most financially practical morning warehouse jobs available anywhere in the logistics market.
